answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 7470 Country: India Title: If some donates an land for an mosque can this mosque be named in memory of person who has died. Question: If some donates an land for an mosque can this mosque be named in memory of person who has died. Answer ID: 7470 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 877/877=M/1429) The mosque name can be named after the waqif (endower). In the abovementioned case, it is better to choose a better name with mutual advice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
